title: Find the Sum of Subsequence Powers
summary: Given an integer array nums and a positive integer k, calculate the sum of the minimum absolute differences between any two elements in all subsequences of length k.
statement: Given an integer array nums and a positive integer k, calculate the sum of the minimum absolute differences between any two elements in all subsequences of length k. Return the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: The power of a chosen length-k subsequence is the minimum absolute difference between any two selected values.
Sum the powers of all index subsequences modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: After sorting selected values, the minimum pairwise difference occurs between adjacent selected values.
Memoize by scan index, previous selected index, remaining selections, and minimum gap so far.
Skip or take each value; on take update minGap with current-previous; return minGap after exactly k takes.
The recursion enumerates every index subset once, and adjacent-gap updates maintain precisely its power under sorted order.
editorial: The recursion enumerates every index subset once, and adjacent-gap updates maintain precisely its power under sorted order.

tests.explanation: The four triples have minimum gaps one, one, one, and one, so their powers sum to four.
The three index pairs have differences zero, one, and one, summing to two.
